Title: Histoire générale des Églises Évangéliques des Vallées de Piémont ou Vaudoises, Livre second
Creator: Jean Léger, pasteur et modérateur des Églises des Vallées, afterwards of the Walloon church of Leiden
Publisher: Leiden: Jean Le Carpentier
Publication Date: 1669
Rights: Public Domain (printed at Leiden in 1669; public domain by date under the project's 95-year rule)
Language: fra
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_Yf_DYoc9lb0C, file bub_gb_Yf_DYoc9lb0C_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (Public Domain Mark); contributor National Library of Naples; no access-restricted-item flag.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged (no characters altered; the raw file contains 0 long-s glyphs, so no long-s normalisation was done; the OCR renders the 1669 long s as the letter f, left as scanned). Rights basis restated: a book printed at Leiden in 1669 is public domain by date.
Content note: Book II only, of two: the persecutions suffered by the valleys 'since the Inquisition began to reign over Christians' to 1664, including the Easter 1655 massacre with Léger's lists of the killed by name and place, the Pignerol treaty, and the events of 1663-64 (Janavel). Book I is vendored beside it from Internet Archive item bub_gb_kzsAtn028N8C. OCR sampled at 10/30/50/70/90% and found readable French in the body with long s as f, many broken words, and garbled title page, marginal notes and closing pages; second witness for wording until a cleaner scan is vendored.
